title: cargo clippy -D warnings — redundant & 2 处 (uuid + logs)
description:
PR #152 canary 抓到 `cargo clippy -- -D warnings` FAIL. 至少 2 处 redundant reference warning.

**已 confirmed warnings (raw from PR #152 log run 30204297702)**:
- `&uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string()[..8].to_uppercase()` — help: remove redundant `&`
- 类似模式还有 1 处 (uuid duplicate)
- `&logs` — help: try `&logs` (可能是 `&&logs` double ref)

**修法**: `cd rust && cargo clippy --fix --allow-dirty -- -D warnings` (auto-fix) 或手动改 (小改动).

**Performer 步骤**:
1. 本地跑 `cd rust && cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings 2>&1 | tee /tmp/clippy.log` 抓全部 warning
2. 修复 (每处 diff 抽查 whitespace/refs)
3. cargo test --workspace --release 验证无 regression

**追责链**: main 分支 CI 严格 `-D warnings` 首次真跑到 (v3.30.1 canary), 之前 miao 从没跑 clippy.
